derrame.evidencia: The tank is at {{nivelTanque}} % and the pump is still delivering (motor load {{cargaMotor}} %).
derrame.consecuencia: If the pump does not stop, the level can reach the overflow and spill water into the bund.
derrame.accion: Confirm that the high-level cut-out is working and that the control loop responds.

marcha-en-seco.evidencia: The tank is at {{nivelTanque}} % —below the {{minNivel}} % mark— and the pump is delivering (load {{cargaMotor}} %).
marcha-en-seco.consecuencia: Drawing with insufficient level causes cavitation and can destroy the mechanical seal and the bearings in a short time.
marcha-en-seco.accion: Check the actual level and the low-level protection before pumping any further.

sobrepresion.evidencia: Gauge pressure {{presionRelativa}} with the pump delivering (load {{cargaMotor}} %).
sobrepresion.consecuencia: Holding the network above its service pressure punishes gaskets, seals and the weakest runs, and can cause a rupture.
sobrepresion.accion: Review the VFD setpoint and the state of the relief valve.

obstruccion.evidencia: High pressure ({{presionRelativa}}) with low flow ({{flujoInstantaneo}}) and the motor loaded to {{cargaMotor}} %.
obstruccion.consecuencia: The pump is pushing against a resistance: consistent with a closed valve, a dirty filter or a blockage in the line. Working like this heats the pump and wastes energy.
obstruccion.accion: Check the valves on the discharge line and the condition of the filters.

bomba-sin-salida.titulo: The pump is running against a closed outlet
bomba-sin-salida.evidencia: Flow {{flujoInstantaneo}} —practically nil— with pressure {{presionRelativa}} and the pump delivering (load {{cargaMotor}} %).
bomba-sin-salida.consecuencia: With no flow there is no water to carry the heat away: all the shaft power stays inside the pump, heating the same trapped liquid. The mechanical seal and the impeller are damaged in minutes, not weeks, and the steam that forms can burst the volute.
bomba-sin-salida.accion: Check whether the discharge valve is closed and whether there is a minimum recirculation line. Stop the pump rather than opening it suddenly: opening against a hot pump sends a water hammer into the network.
bomba-sin-salida.nota: The «there is pressure» threshold is still an estimate of ours, not a figure from the plant.

posible-fuga.evidencia: High flow ({{flujoInstantaneo}}) with low pressure ({{presionRelativa}}) and the pump delivering.
posible-fuga.consecuencia: Plenty of flow with no pressure is what you see when the network is open somewhere: consistent with a leak, a burst or an outlet left open.
posible-fuga.accion: Walk the network looking for an abnormal discharge and compare against the expected consumption.

esfuerzo-sin-resultado.titulo: The motor is working and moving little
esfuerzo-sin-resultado.evidencia: Motor load {{cargaMotor}} % moving a flow of {{flujoInstantaneo}}.
esfuerzo-sin-resultado.consecuencia: High consumption with no hydraulic work in return. Consistent with a worn impeller, a blockage or a mechanical problem, and sustained it heats the motor.
esfuerzo-sin-resultado.accion: Compare against the pump's usual operating point at that load.

tension-fuera-con-motor.titulo: Supply out of tolerance with the motor under load
tension-fuera-con-motor.evidencia: Line voltage {{tensionLinea}} V, outside the {{minTension}}–{{maxTension}} V range, with the motor at {{cargaMotor}} %.
tension-fuera-con-motor.consecuencia: Feeding a loaded motor out of tolerance overheats the windings and shortens their life; below the minimum it also raises the current drawn.
tension-fuera-con-motor.accion: Review the supply and the VFD protections.

variador-en-manual.evidencia: The VFD mode reads as Manual.
variador-en-manual.consecuencia: In Manual the automatic systems that protect the plant may not act: control depends on whoever is operating.
variador-en-manual.accion: Confirm that operating in Manual is intentional and that somebody is attending to it.
variador-en-manual.nota: The Automatic/Manual correspondence is not confirmed on the server.

agua-caliente.evidencia: The water in the tank is at {{temperaturaTanque}} °C.
agua-caliente.consecuencia: Above its service band the water loses its fitness for the process, and if it keeps rising the risk of cavitation at the suction increases.
agua-caliente.accion: Check the heat input and the turnover of the tank.

sobrecorriente-o-cortocircuito.titulo: Overcurrent at the output (F1): short circuit, earth fault or a badly parameterised motor

sobretension-de-bus.titulo: DC link overvoltage (F2): deceleration too fast, or a high supply

subtension-de-alimentacion.titulo: Supply undervoltage (F3): a dip or a brief outage on the mains

sobretemperatura.titulo: Drive or motor overtemperature (F4, F5, F11): ventilation or duty cycle

disparo-de-vigilancia-de-carga.titulo: Load monitoring trip (F452): a mechanical fault in the drive train, or a seizure

corte-nivel-alto-no-actua.titulo: The automatic high-level cut-out is not acting

nivel-real-insuficiente.titulo: The actual tank level is insufficient

proteccion-nivel-bajo-no-actua.titulo: The low-level protection is not acting

consigna-variador-alta.titulo: The VFD setpoint is above what it should be

valvula-alivio-no-actua.titulo: The relief valve is not acting

fuga-o-rotura-en-la-red.titulo: Leak, burst or an outlet left open in the network

obstruccion-interna-bomba.titulo: Internal blockage in the pump or the line

problema-en-el-suministro.titulo: A problem in the electrical supply

aporte-termico-externo.titulo: External heat input to the tank

falta-renovacion-de-agua.titulo: Not enough water turnover in the tank

rodamiento-en-mal-estado.titulo: Bearing in poor condition at that support

fijacion-floja-en-el-apoyo.componente: Fixing bolts of the indicated support

desalineacion-localizada.titulo: Coupling misalignment pulling on that side
desalineacion-localizada.componente: Coupling, on the side of the indicated support

cavitacion-acumulada.componente: Mechanical seal and impeller of the pump
cavitacion-acumulada.mecanismo: With a low level, the pressure at the suction falls below the vapour pressure and bubbles form that implode against the impeller. Each implosion tears off a minute amount of material; the damage accumulates and does not undo itself.
cavitacion-acumulada.consecuencia: Impeller erosion, a progressive loss of flow at the same speed, and destruction of the mechanical seal — which is usually what fails first, and what forces the pump open.
cavitacion-acumulada.accion: Review the low-level stop setpoint and the reaction time of the loop.

sobrepresion-sostenida.titulo: Hours with the network above its service pressure
sobrepresion-sostenida.componente: Gaskets, seals and the weakest runs of the network
sobrepresion-sostenida.mecanismo: The elastomers in gaskets and seals deform permanently under sustained pressure (compression set). It is not a failure from exceeding a limit once: it is fatigue proportional to the time accumulated above the design pressure.
sobrepresion-sostenida.consecuencia: Leaks at gaskets, a progressive loss of tightness and, at worst, a run rupturing from fatigue.
sobrepresion-sostenida.accion: Review the VFD setpoint and the setting of the relief valve.

agua-caliente-sostenida.titulo: Hours with the water above its band
agua-caliente-sostenida.componente: Pump suction and fitness of the water
agua-caliente-sostenida.mecanismo: The hotter the water, the lower the pressure at which it boils, and the less suction margin the pump has left before it cavitates. Hot water does no damage on its own: it narrows the margin everything else works with.
agua-caliente-sostenida.consecuencia: It raises the chance of cavitation at levels that used to be sufficient, and the water stops being fit for its process use.
agua-caliente-sostenida.accion: Check the heat input and the turnover of the tank.

tension-fuera-de-tolerancia.titulo: Hours with the supply out of tolerance
tension-fuera-de-tolerancia.componente: Motor windings and the drive DC link
tension-fuera-de-tolerancia.mecanismo: Below tolerance, the motor makes up the torque by drawing more current, and current heats the winding. Above it, the core saturates and iron losses rise. In both directions the result is the same variable: insulation temperature. The classic rule —Montsinger, taken up in IEC 60034-1— is that insulation life halves for every 10 K sustained above its class.
tension-fuera-de-tolerancia.consecuencia: Accelerated ageing of the stator insulation and of the capacitors in the drive DC link. Neither gives warning: they fail all at once, at the end.
tension-fuera-de-tolerancia.accion: Review the supply and the VFD protections.

esfuerzo-sin-resultado.titulo: Hours moving little flow with the motor loaded
esfuerzo-sin-resultado.mecanismo: Working far from the best efficiency point loads the shaft asymmetrically: the radial force on the impeller grows and unloads entirely onto the bearings.
esfuerzo-sin-resultado.consecuencia: Accelerated wear of bearings and of the seal, and consumption with no useful work.
esfuerzo-sin-resultado.accion: Compare the real operating point against the pump's curve.
